intent: Verify the Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer (fastener type bolt, diameter 8 mm) catalogue variant exists and check whether it also carries the claimed extra fastener type 'threaded rod'; answer <NO> with the checked SKU if that extra claim is absent.
success_criteria: Locate the catalogue variant in the HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer line with fastener type bolt and diameter 8 mm
Confirm whether that variant's properties include fastener type 'threaded rod'
If base variant exists but lacks the threaded-rod claim, answer <NO> and cite the matched product record_path plus checked SKU

args.stdin: SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path, pv.product_name, ft.property_value_text AS fastener_type, dm.property_value_number AS diameter_mm, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties tr WHERE tr.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND tr.property_key = 'fastener_type' AND tr.property_value_text = :claimed_fastener_type) AS has_threaded_rod_claim FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties ft ON ft.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND ft.property_key = 'fastener_type' JOIN product_variant_properties dm ON dm.product_sku = pv.product_sku AND dm.property_key = 'diameter_mm' WHERE pv.brand = :brand AND pv.model = :model AND ft.property_value_text = :fastener_type AND dm.property_value_number = :diameter_mm;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: <NO> Checked catalogue item {matched.product_sku} ({matched.record_path}): the Heco Zinc Plated HECO 3DW-64B Nut Bolt and Washer variant with fastener type bolt and diameter 8 mm exists, but its catalogue record carries fastener type 'bolt' only — it does NOT include the claimed extra fastener type 'threaded rod'. The support note's extra claim is unsupported.
